exposure: pregnancy antitissue transglutaminase immunoglobulin A (tTG-IgA) seropositivity
outcome: celiac-related conditions in pregnancy (diabetes, nutritional deficiency, gastrointestinal complications, Down syndrome child, cesarean delivery, thyroiditis)
cohort: Pregnant women enrolled from 1959 to 1967 in the Child Health and Development Studies and their offspring.
finding: Pregnancy tTG-IgA seropositivity was associated with having 2 or more maternal high-risk markers, lower placental to birth weight ratio, and lower infant weight gain in late infancy.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was identified as one of the maternal high-risk markers associated with tTG-IgA seropositivity (OR 2.6, 95% CI 1.2-5.3 for 2+ markers).
